id.description: The ID of this Filter State

user_id.description: The ID of the User that owns this Filter State

label.description: The user friendly label for this Filter State. Always present when the Filter State is visible

hidden.description: When true this Filter State is not listed as a preset but can still be referenced

version.description: The client defined version of the state format

state.description: Opaque client defined filter state. Any JSON value. Immutable once created

time_created.description: The time this Filter State was created

time_updated.description: The last time this Filter State was edited

time_deleted.description: When this Filter State was soft deleted, or null if active

CreateFilterStateRequest.description: A new Filter State. The request body is limited to 64 KiB. A User has at most one active Filter State per distinct state: creating one whose state already exists returns the existing Filter State, un-hiding and labeling it when it was hidden.

label.description: The label for the Filter State. Required unless hidden is true

hidden.description: When true the Filter State is not listed as a preset

version.description: The client defined version of the state format

state.description: Opaque client defined filter state. Any JSON value

UpdateFilterStateRequest.description: A partial update of a Filter State; only the fields present are changed. The version and state are immutable.

hidden.description: Whether the Filter State is listed as a preset. A Filter State without a label cannot be made visible
